bends.note: Florence turns from NNE (north part, west edge running to the tip of the sliver island at 2435,1500) to SW (south part, ~30 deg steeper); bend point from the two centrelines, +/-30 px; Concord, McGregor and both Florence legs open into one wide junction
turns from SW to WSW at Manitou; continues WSW past the bottom of the drawn area (would cross May south of Manitou, off the drawn map)
at Monroe Kenton turns SSE onto the Kenton St. Bridge (elevated), passes over Florence Avenue with no junction and lands on Gilbert Avenue opposite Nassau

notes: Bare names given 'Street' (Wilkinson, May, Monroe, Manitou, Kenton, Concord, Nassau). Windsor printed 'WINDSOR S..' cut off at the sheet edge, taken as Windsor Street. Sinton printed 'SINTON AV. (GRAND)'. Clifton Alley printed 'CLIFTON ALLEY' between McGregor and Monroe; same 20 ft alley line in all blocks. Farran Alley (printed FARRAN ALLEY) runs only Wilkinson-McGregor and stops at McGregor. Concord: west edge the block line x ~2260, east edge a vertical line x ~2434 that, with Florence's west edge, encloses a sliver island tapering south to a tip at about (2435,1500); south of the tip Concord, McGregor and Florence merge in one wide junction: McGregor ends at Concord (T at 2348,1995), Concord joins the SW leg of Florence (T at 2347,2133), Florence bends at about (2395,2050). Monroe ends at Kenton. The bridge is recorded as part of Kenton Street (bend at Monroe, T at Gilbert at the same point as Nassau, so Kenton bridge / Gilbert / Nassau is effectively a cross). A separate short 25 ft street printed KENTON (paste also says 'NO NAME' at the Gilbert end) runs ESE from Florence to Gilbert; named 'Kenton Street (Florence to Gilbert)' to keep it apart. Manitou merges into Florence where Florence bends; Clifton Alley meets Manitou opposite the Florence roadway (T). Sinton/Gilbert is a very acute junction: the centreline crossing lies well north of the block point (block apex at about 2968,2865). Gilbert SE side north of Windsor and the Windsor south edge are partly under the Fenton United Cleaning paste.
